written.headline: Profile highlights Jensen Huang as he returns as Nvidia CEO
written.summary: Jensen Huang has returned as Nvidia's CEO, according to a profile detailing his ability to make the most of any situation. Longtime friends and associates describe him as having an unrelenting resourcefulness.

written.headline: Adi Vaani platform expands AI translation for tribal languages
written.summary: IIT Delhi and the Ministry of Tribal Affairs have developed Adi Vaani, an AI platform that supports ten tribal languages with speech-to-speech translation and other tools. The app has recorded approximately 48,000 downloads, addressing data scarcity and communication gaps in low-resource indigenous languages.

written.headline: Rise of personal AI agents prompts businesses to rethink infrastructure access
written.summary: The emergence of autonomous personal AI agents capable of shopping, booking services, and initiating payments is forcing ecommerce platforms, payment companies, and banks to reconsider how they grant access to their digital infrastructure. While Swiggy is opening its services to third-party AI agents, businesses risk losing direct customer relationships and behavioral insights.
